# algosec_url_categories (Data Source)

Read Panorama URL-category overrides. Requires the administrator-prepared URL categories override file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_url_categories" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `categories` (Attributes List) Categories ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories))
- `id` (String) Inventory identity.

<a id="nestedatt--categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `categories`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Category name.
- `name` (String) Category name.
- `urls` (Map of Set of String) URL strings mapped to sets of individual IP addresses.
